items.text: Among registered and licensed practical nurses on 18 adult inpatient units responding in a four-week winter window, is a last shift that ran at least 10 percent below planned nursing hours associated with a higher prevalence of at least one missed care activity than a shift at or above plan, after adjustment for unit acuity that day?
items.population: Registered and licensed practical nurses on 18 adult inpatient units
items.intervention: Shift at least 10 percent below planned nursing hours (exposure)
items.comparator: Shift at or above planned hours
items.outcome: At least one of 22 care activities reported missed on the last shift
items.time: Last shift worked, four-week window in winter 2027

items.text: What proportion of nurses report each of the 22 care activities missed on their last shift, by role and shift type?

finer: Feasible with paid survey time and existing scheduling data; interesting to management and the union; novel locally; ethical under the REB approval with unit-level reporting; relevant to the budget round.
summary: One analytic PECO question and one descriptive question.
